caption:
Cash user: are ATM fees costing you ₹1,104 a year?

After the free monthly limit, banks can charge up to ₹23 per ATM withdrawal, plus taxes (since 1 May 2025).
Free each month: 5 at your own bank's ATMs; at other banks, 3 in metros and 5 elsewhere.
Balance checks and mini statements count toward the free limit too.
Illustrative: 4 extra withdrawals a month × 12 × ₹23 = ₹1,104 a year, before taxes.
